evidence.note: Real ERP УХ 3.2.12.6 1cv8.cf storage entries, extracted with `ibcmd-rs cf extract <cf> <form-uuid>.0 <outdir>` (compression raw-deflate). Same root cause as the form-mobile-device-command-bar-content-navigator-gap fixture: both forms carry a built-in Navigator/quick-search child item, which writes one extra field between the root child-items count-list and the classic 24-member form-root trailer -- a 25-member trailer, not 24. `extract_form_save_window_settings` (src/mssql_dump/form_body.rs) previously read a fixed absolute offset `tail_start + 23` (the trailer's last slot under the 24-shape only) located via the strict `[24]`-only `form_root_child_items_tail_start`; for a 25-member trailer that search found no valid count-list at all and the whole property silently disappeared. The property's value is genuinely the trailer's *last* field regardless of shape (confirmed: absolute last field of `fields` is unchanged whether the count-list search targets 24 or 25), so the fix reads `trailer.len() - 1` off the already-fixed `form_root_child_items_tail_start_50_with_navigator_gap` instead of a fixed offset.
